description: ARVO connects a user's private workout plan and training history to ChatGPT. Users can review today's session, their active split, recent workouts, personal records, exercise progression, volume, and coaching insights; start workouts; log sets; adapt exercises; update training preferences; and generate personalized workouts. ARVO is a fitness tool and does not provide medical advice.

defaultPrompt: Make me a 4-day workout plan to build muscle.
Coach me through my leg workout set by set.
Summarize my progress and what to change next week.
